transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, the Battalion S-6. Before I publish the binding network access plan for tomorrow, I need to confirm service requirements from each of you. We have three protected network segments available -- Red, Blue, and Green -- and three service windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Each service -- the command video brief, the logistics synchronization feed, and the clinic records system -- will be assigned one segment and one window. Please provide your requirements so we can finalize the plan. Also note that each service must have a documented configuration control before its access window begins, so let me know if there are any issues on that front.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the command video brief: it must use Segment Green and the 1400-1500 window. I received confirmation this morning that the partner headquarters bridge is configured only for that segment and time. This isn't on the change-control board slide yet, but it's a confirmed constraint we need to build into the plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the logistics synchronization feed: it must use Segment Blue and the 1000-1100 window. I confirmed today with the depot technician that the legacy terminal only accepts the Blue segment profile, and the depot upload begins at 1000. This hasn't been added to the network request yet, but it's a confirmed constraint we need to build into the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a hard requirement for the clinic records system: it must use Segment Red and the 0800-0900 window. The clinic server's isolation certificate is valid only on Segment Red, and the morning patient-file reconciliation starts at 0800. I received the certificate record from the clinic administrator this morning, but it hasn't been entered in the access worksheet yet. This is a confirmed constraint we need to build into the plan.
transcript.speaker: A4
